OPERATOR QUESTION M-S02-002 — Invoked bundled grill-with-docs (grilling + domain-modeling). Public facts: enabled gates scheduled starts; disabled jobs allow manual runs; existing Runs retry by max_attempts; no queue/catch-up scheduler exists; dashboard shows Enabled and Last result. Current independent decision frontier:
Q1 Pause scope: Should pause block only new scheduled Runs, or also manual Runs / retries / in-flight Runs? Recommended: only new scheduled Runs; existing/manual Runs, retries, alerts remain unchanged.
Q2 Enabled relationship: Should paused be a separate persistent Job state, so pause/resume preserve enabled (including disabled jobs), or alias enabled/disabled? Recommended: separate persistent paused state; resume cannot enable a disabled Job.
Q3 Repeated/missing operations: Should repeated pause/resume succeed idempotently with 200 and {job: ...}, and missing Job return existing 404? Recommended: yes; no request body required.
Q4 Visibility: Should Jobs API expose paused and dashboard add a Paused column while preserving Enabled and Last result? Recommended: yes.
Please answer this frontier. I will recompute dependencies and request shared-understanding confirmation before implementation if your reply does not already confirm it.

OPERATOR ANSWER Q1: A scheduled start while paused is skipped and not queued. Manual Runs remain allowed while paused. An in-progress Run continues to its terminal outcome, including existing retries and alerts. Q2/Q3/Q4: no additional product preference or interface guidance is supplied; use TASK.md, existing public interfaces and reversible engineering judgment for representation, enabled-state handling, idempotence/missing-Job responses and presentation. These answers cover requested product decisions only, not blanket confirmation of every recommended policy or unasked behavior.

OPERATOR QUESTION M-S02-002 — Recomputed frontier is empty: Q1 settles product scope; Q2–Q4 are delegated reversible engineering judgments. Shared understanding for confirmation: pause skips new scheduled starts with no queue/catch-up; manual Runs and already-started Runs continue, including retries/alerts. I will represent pause separately from enabled, so resume preserves disabled state, use idempotent bodyless 200 {job} pause/resume with existing 404 for absent jobs, expose paused in Jobs JSON and add dashboard Paused visibility preserving Enabled/Last result. These are local engineering choices, not assertions of supplied product guidance. Please confirm the shared product understanding so the bundled grilling completion condition is met before implementation.

OPERATOR ANSWER to the confirmation you now requested: resume applies to future schedule activity only, with no catch-up. Your restatement of scheduled skip/no queue, manual allowance and in-progress continuation matches the earlier answers. Representation, enabled-state preservation, idempotence/response shape and dashboard presentation remain your engineering choices, not additional product preferences supplied by me. This confirms only the explicitly asked product understanding.
